newsitem.title: USA: CSX Corp sees positive fourth quarter.
newsitem.headline: CSX Corp sees positive fourth quarter.

text.p: CSX Corp said on Wednesday its outlook for the fourth quarter was positive, with pressures from high fuel costs, grain shortages and container-shipping trade lines rates largely over.

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer John Snow said: "The volume of business continues to grow at our core businesses, and we foresee no significant obstacles to sustained economic strength here and abroad."

The international transportation company, which said on Tuesday it agreed to merge with Conrail Inc, reported third quarter 1996 earnings of $1.04 per share compared to $0.96 in the same period last year.
"These strong results were achieved under difficult conditions," Snow said. Hurrican Fran was also an obstacle in the quarter, he said.
Snow said CSX overcame obstacles by stringently managing expenses and improving productivity.
